notes.title: Echoes: Patch Notes #2
notes.content:
Minor Changes & Fixes



     Better Game Explanation:
    Improved in-game tutorials and hints.

     Audio Fixes:
    Resolved issues with certain audio elements, including glitches and volume inconsistencies. The soundscape is now smoother and more immersive, enhancing the horror experience.

notes.title: Patch Notes #1
notes.content:
Minor Changes & Fixes


     Locker Fixes:
    Resolved several bugs with lockers that caused inconsistent interactions. Lockers should now behave as intended, ensuring a smoother gameplay experience.

     Sanity Level Visual:
    Added a new visual indicator for your character's sanity level. 

     Improved Radio Mechanics:
    Adjustments made to make the radio more user-friendly and intuitive.
